component.name: Pattern Mode Selector
component.purpose: Switch a drum or synth Pattern Engine Panel between MIDI Generation and MIDI Circular Pattern while preserving clear applied, pending, disabled, and error state.

rules: Render both pattern mode options at all selectable densities.
Keep the applied active mode selected until the engine publishes an applied snapshot.
Show pending target and pending boundary without resizing the selector.
Keep disabled expected modes visible with an accessible reason.
Show selector-level errors without clearing the last valid active mode.
UI requests mode switches but does not schedule MIDI events.
While transport is playing, default requestedBoundary is nextBar unless a lane contract narrows it.
Switch replacement requires engine confirmation before the visible pending target changes.
activeMode is the currently applied scheduling source.
pendingMode is null when no switch is waiting.
lastError is scoped to the selector or owning lane.
Snapshots are the source of truth for rendered active and pending states.
Timestamp pattern events in the engine, not from UI event timing.
Preserve note-on and note-off pairing through mode switches.
Schedule old-mode note-offs before or at the switch boundary when required.
Preserve deterministic ordering for simultaneous events.
Keep scheduler lookahead and pending switch queues bounded.
Keep panic/all-notes-off available from the shell for recovery.

acceptance: Every Drums and Synth pattern surface exposes Generation and Circular options without a dropdown.
Active and pending modes are visually and semantically distinct.
Pending switches show their boundary and keep the last applied mode active.
Collapsed summaries preserve active mode, pending target, and error state.
Generation and Circular controls document ranges and apply timing.
The UI consumes engine snapshots and does not drive musical scheduling directly.
The contract accounts for note-off safety, deterministic ordering, bounded pending work, and panic recovery.
